title: SAEBench Domain Stress Test: How Much Does Evaluation Domain Affect SAE Rankings?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Safety auditing needs to generalize across diverse inputs. If SAE quality metrics are domain-sensitive, practitioners cannot trust benchmark scores for production audit decisions. Clear chain from domain sensitivity measurement to improved safety tooling trust calibration.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pre-trained SAEs available on Neuronpedia, SAEBench metrics already implemented, SAELens handles inference. No training required. Code and dialogue corpora are publicly available. Beginners run existing evaluation code on new data. Very accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Take existing SAEs, run existing metrics on two new corpora, report ranking changes. Minimal custom code needed. Single model, existing evaluation framework, clear deliverable as a comparison table. Easily fits 30 hours.

novelty.reasoning: No novelty assessment available; default estimated score assigned.
